# `factory/asbuilt_graph.py`

[As built](../../README.md) › [As-built architecture mapping](../../subsystems/as-built-architecture-mapping.md) › `asbuilt_graph.py`

As built at `4b8570d19ee1`, read 2026-10-07.

Validates and joins repository readings into a checked structural graph: confirms imports and function definitions against source code, clusters files into subsystems and parts, computes capabilities and their reach, and tracks how code is organized.

1,878 lines, in As-built architecture mapping.

| **Assembling the structural graph** — Builds the checked graph by resolving links between files, matching routes to the tests that cover them, and deriving stable names and IDs for ways in. Centers on build, resolve_link, and match_route, which carry the file's core assembly logic. | 385 | 11 | `build` | 5 · 0 |
| **Classifying findings and capabilities** — Detects what changed in the system and assigns subsystems and capabilities to those changes, producing labelled findings. | **Tracing call reach through source** — Walks function bodies to compute how far a call reaches, indexing calls and imports and locating the span of each unit of code. source_notes and reach drive this, supported by _call_index, _follow, and _fn_lines for locating and bounding code regions. | 251 | 8 | `source_notes` | 0 · 3 |
| **Applying architecture metadata** — Carries architecture prompts and configuration mentions onto the graph, and flags routes that nothing calls. apply_architecture and carry_architecture do the core work, with _configures and mentions_of locating where setup is referenced. | 214 | 7 | `apply_architecture` | 1 · 0 |
| **Clustering files into parts** — Runs Louvain-style community detection to split files into subsystems and parts, then checks how much calling crosses between the resulting groups. louvain and _split perform the clustering, while part_crossings measures how clean the split is. | 180 | 4 | `louvain` | 0 · 2 |
